name: io.github.ashon/supragnosis
title: supragnosis
description: Memory for AI agents that remembers who said it.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open. The MCP transport here is stdio, so the container speaks the protocol on its standard streams.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: The container is disposable. Everything that must survive it is in the volume below.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: REQUIRED. The knowledge, the node key and the config all live here. The node key is written once and the node identity derives from it permanently, so a run without this volume is not a restarted node - it is a new one, with an empty log.

state.description: A named docker volume, or an absolute path on the host, to keep the knowledge in.

packageArguments.description: Foreground run on stdio. The image's default command starts an HTTP daemon instead, which is the shape a federation hub wants and not what an MCP client should launch.
